canonical_name: No Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management Program
description: A cybersecurity supply chain risk management program and strategy are not established.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Organizations with supplier and third-party relationships Procurement and vendor management teams Supply chain security programs

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for the absence of documented supply chain risk management programs, strategies, objectives, policies, or processes. Check for lack of stakeholder agreement or formal approval of SCRM initiatives.
